notes: Universal Return Engine. Installer Return and Customer Return now share a Return to Warehouse workflow with Return Source (Installer / Customer) separated from Returned Material (General Stock / Carpet). General stock returns route to the exact Product Inventory record and add back the product's own unit; carpet returns stay in Carpet Inventory, with Installer carpet leftovers using source-roll child-roll traceability and Customer carpet returns using returned-roll intake. Multi-item returns keep one Return Source while each item routes independently by material. Existing specific return shortcuts remain compatible.
